title: Guarded nondeterministic program configuration
statement: For an NARM $A$, an oracle, a multi-tape machine $D$, a state assignment $q_0$, natural-number bounds $B,W$, a Boolean input $x$, and an abstract configuration $a$, define the guard condition to hold when $NPre(A,\mathrm{oracle},D,q_0,B,x,a)$ holds and, for every register $r$, the binary representation of the register value plus one has length at most $W$ (that is, $|(\mathrm{bits}(a_r+1))|\le W$).
hypotheses_covered: An oracle from Fin d to Boolean lists
A kD-tape Boolean multi-tape Turing machine D
A state assignment q₀ from Fin d to the machine's states
caveat: The supplied statement does not define NPre, so its condition cannot be expanded into a self-contained mathematical description.
